evidenceOnlyValidation.validationScopeLabel: Supplied research and saved sources only; no application ID, effective-reader, runtime-guard, build, UI or publication validation.
limitations: No new public-web research, live-stock refresh, dealer contact, accepted order, physical inspection or VIN build-sheet lookup.
Exact technical-epoch stock badges remain unverified; dated named-trim NEW advertisement evidence is independently preserved.
Source integrity and mutation checks validate only this research proposal; application binding and runtime validation must be done by main.
No catalogue data, homepage, original Model Y hero9, runtime code or deployment was modified.

applicationValidation.scope: Actual effective catalogue, all mapped values/source wrapper audit, and unchanged shared-reader mutation validation

featureAudit.copyBinding: Sourced supplemental equipment_ facts. The narrow feature-grid aliases are separate; other unverified criteria remain unknown.

checks: Actual catalogue(), effectiveFeatures() and research().sources produce 10 summaries and all 20 clauses through the unchanged shared reader
All 186 executable guards exactly match current effective facts or formal MY, full identity snapshots and source metadata

Every guarded fact value, status, unit, basis, comparisonBasis, market, scope, qualification, explanation, stale date, issue and source-membership mutation suppresses precisely dependent clauses; all formal-MY mutations suppress dependent records/clauses
Both reader stages fail closed on every missing, stale, held, conflicted, access-limited or non-HTTP source
Loss of current/order-listed record state or changed availability revision suppresses the exact record
Changed/expired prices leave all technical clauses eligible within their independent freshness window
All copy fails closed after the 30-day evidence window
Five formal-MY nulls, seven unverified exact-stock states, three advertisement-only stock states and Chery-only explicit order acceptance remain intact; delivery is always unverified

Manufacturer epochs, C10 neutral generation/ATM/conflicted consumption, Deepal optional fitment/source units/structured roof/warranties, E07 recall and AC holds, and Chery cable/DC-peak/towing/VDA load-height holds all match the final effective catalogue

Targeted mutations reject B05/B10 trim swaps, C10 residual-battery/charging/consumption substitutions, S07 wheel and SOC-window changes, E07 assumed recall clearance or resolved AC time, and Chery cable/DC-peak/towing/cargo confusion
limitations: Runtime enforces source freshness and eligibility, not exact equality of otherwise valid URLs, fresh access/publication dates or source metadata. Those full source wrappers are separately snapshot-audited.

Runtime directly guards exact variant IDs, formal MY, referenced fact scope/drive/battery/wheels, listing state and availability revision. Arbitrary display labels/generation and nested stock/order fields are audited snapshots, not independent runtime guards; copy makes no stock or delivery promise.

Source-less nulls remain audit-only; all key sourced-null conflicts and E07 recall applicability are executable guards. Held residual/future records and existing refreshes remain outside the ten summaries.
No application files edited, no publication or full build/UI/browser validation claimed.
